result.topic_en: A page from Gauss's notebook. It has faded German notes on the rotation period of Saturn's ring (Herschel's discovery) and a German historical note on the isoperimetric problem (Bernoullis, Taylor, Euler). Below these are algebraic calculations factoring $(a+b)^7-a^7-b^7$ and a Latin remark giving a more elegant solution of Newton's problem 37 in the Arithmetica Universalis (a circle tangent to a given line through two given points), with sketches.

items.english: The problem Newton proposes in the Arithmetica Universalis no. 37, to describe a circle that touches a line given in position and passes through two given points, could have been solved much more elegantly.
